title: UPI Payment Scam Warning
summary: Fraudsters are sending fake UPI payment failure messages with links to collect payments. These links lead to phishing sites that steal UPI credentials.
recommendation: Never click on payment links in unsolicited messages. Use official UPI apps for transactions. Verify payment status within the app itself.

title: QR Code Safety Guidelines
summary: QR code scams where fraudsters replace legitimate merchant QR codes or send fake QR code payment requests through messages.
recommendation: Always verify the merchant name before making QR payments. Do not scan QR codes received via SMS or WhatsApp from unknown senders.
